result.rationale: Cinco is a Rowan project matching the existing platform. Merge is unsafe because Cinco's members and Rowan's post-recap active cap table—including UPP treatment and exact holders, stakes, votes and governance—are not public.

identityResolution.finding: Rowan Cinco/Cinco Data Center/Project Cinco=one subordinate campus; Cinco 1=first 300MW phase.
identityResolution.entities: Rowan Cinco LLC (f/k/a Rowan Land Resources LLC)=Delaware project SPV/borrower; Rowan Green Data LLC (formed 2020-11-16)=historical JV; separately formed Rowan Digital Infrastructure LLC (2025-07-14)=current platform/parent, not a proven rename.
identityResolution.chain: Cinco labels -> Rowan Cinco LLC -> UNRESOLVED members/intermediates -> Rowan platform

ownershipResolution.platform: Birch pleads initial Quinbrook control/board majority and a 2021 transfer of Birch's interest to Rowan Management Co LLC; member status is uncertified. Quinbrook said Rowan was wholly owned by January 2023. Blackstone affiliates later acquired a significant minority. Islington/Apex reports a 49% sale/51% Fund retention; those are LP-reported economics, not a party cap table, and UPP makes the company denominator unclear. Blackstone fund/vehicle, issuer/security, sellers, mix, exact stakes/votes/control and UPP treatment remain UNRESOLVED; Quinbrook's managing partner remained chairman.
ownershipResolution.cincoEquity: No Cinco co-owner/JV disclosed; LLC members uncertified.
ownershipResolution.nonEquity: Design LLC=occupant; Google LLC=operator; TD (Texas)/lenders=secured creditors; Medina County=tax counterparty.

operatingResolution.location: 440 acres near Lytle, Medina County, Texas
operatingResolution.scope: Cinco 1=300MW; campus power envelope up to 1GW in 2026-2030
operatingResolution.completionEnergization: Cinco 1 target late 2026; broader 300MW completion target 2027; no energization/operation verified.

acquisitionExitCheck.litigation: Birch rescission pending; no equity restored.
